name: Kono Yo de Mottomo Inbi na Kiss
original_name: この世で最も淫靡なキス
source:
April Fools Game.

Shiho attempts to cheat on a school test, but is caught by the PE teacher, Iidabashi. He offers to overlook her in exchange for a favor - she is to approach the strict History teacher, Aizawa, and set him up for a scandal.
